references.text: Hazor is mentioned as a powerful Canaanite city that Joshua conquered, and King Jabin of Hazor was the leader of a coalition against Israel.
Joshua captured and burned Hazor, which was the capital of all these kingdoms. The same city, Hazor, is mentioned here as part of Naphtali's inheritance.
Jabin, king of Canaan, ruled in Hazor during the time of Deborah and Barak, showing the city's continued importance.
King Solomon used forced labor to rebuild Hazor, along with Megiddo and Gezer, demonstrating the city's strategic significance.
The Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser conquered Hazor together with other cities in the region of Naphtali, confirming that Hazor was located within this tribal territory.
